problem_statement: OpenThread's NCP/spinel interface does not support DNS-SD service (SRV) record resolution. When a DNS-SD service resolver request is issued, there is no Spinel property to carry the SRV resolver request from the host to the NCP, no Spinel property to report an SRV resolution result back, and no codec to encode or decode those messages. A service resolver should be startable over the NCP, and the NCP should be able to deliver a resolved service record (service instance, service type, host name, port, priority, weight, TTL, infrastructure interface index, and the request callback context) back to the host. Implementing this requires encoding/decoding the SRV resolver request and the SRV result over Spinel and routing the result to the platform callback.
